findings.F1: American IPA ˈrɛk.ɚd is the noun's stress; the verb is rɪˈkɔrd, as the entry's notes say.
findings.F2: 'record a photo' is not a real collocation; one takes a photo.
findings.F3: Sense 3 definition merges an instrument showing a measurement with achieving an officially noted result.
findings.F4: take-v listed as a synonym of sense 1, with 'take a measurement', which is measuring, not recording.
findings.F5: Verb/noun stress contrast stated in four fields (pronunciation notes, usage note, word-family note, pronunciation adaptation).
findings.F6: Usage note wrongly limits noun 'record' (album) to vinyl discs.
findings.F7: Sense 1 participle phrases (officially recorded and others) filed as adverb + verb instead of phrase.
findings.F8: Sense 2 participle phrases (secretly recorded, digitally recorded) filed as adverb + verb instead of phrase.
